subsystems.name: Sender-side neural readout
subsystems.role: records the brain activity that accompanies a subjective experience.
parts: high-density electrode array or non-invasive sensor

subsystems.name: Decoding model
subsystems.role: turns recorded activity into a description of the experience — smell, emotion, feeling.

subsystems.name: Cross-brain translation map
subsystems.role: the core unsolved part: mapping one person's neural pattern onto another's, since no two brains share a wiring diagram.

subsystems.name: Receiver-side writer
subsystems.role: reproduces the pattern in the receiving cortex.
parts: microelectrode stimulation array or non-invasive stimulator

subsystems.name: Real-time link
subsystems.role: carries and synchronises the signal between the two brains.

subsystems.name: Safety and consent layer
subsystems.role: prevents unintended or unwanted perturbation of the receiver.

buildSteps.title: Record a defined experience
buildSteps.detail: Put the sender in a controlled state (a specific odour, a specific emotion) and record cortical activity with the highest-bandwidth method available.

buildSteps.title: Find the signature
buildSteps.detail: Statistical and machine-learning methods identify which activity patterns reliably correlate with that state rather than with movement, attention or arousal.

buildSteps.title: Extract a portable representation
buildSteps.detail: Abstract the pattern into a form that is not tied to the sender's exact electrode geometry — the hardest technical step, and unresolved.

buildSteps.title: Calibrate the receiver
buildSteps.detail: Map the receiver's cortex so the incoming pattern can be aimed at the anatomically corresponding region.

buildSteps.title: Write the pattern
buildSteps.detail: Stimulation pulses drive the receiver's cortex in the decoded spatiotemporal sequence.

buildSteps.title: Close the loop
buildSteps.detail: Ask the receiver to report what they experienced; compare with the sender's state and adjust the translation model. Repeat across many trials.

buildSteps.title: Increase bandwidth and richness
buildSteps.detail: Move from simple percepts towards richer, more abstract states, adding channels and finer timing control.

buildSteps.title: Test two-way sharing
buildSteps.detail: Make the link bidirectional so both participants can exchange states rather than one broadcasting to the other.

prerequisites.why: implanted arrays read hundreds to thousands of neurons; non-invasive methods read far less. A subjective state involves millions.

prerequisites.tech: Causal neural writing at fine scale
prerequisites.why: cortical stimulation is used clinically and in research, but it produces crude sensations, not faithful experiences.

prerequisites.tech: A coding theory for subjective experience
prerequisites.why: there is no accepted account of how neural activity becomes a felt quality, or whether a given pattern means the same thing in two brains.
brains differ in connectivity and representation, so a pattern from one cortex need not be meaningful in another.

prerequisites.tech: Safety and ethics framework for direct neural exchange
prerequisites.why: writing into someone's brain raises consent and identity questions that current regulation does not address.

pathway.milestone: brain-computer interfaces that decode intended speech or movement and restore simple sensation
pathway.unlocks: proof that specific neural activity can be read out and, crudely, written back.

pathway.milestone: simple brain-to-brain signalling of a binary percept or motor intention between two people
pathway.unlocks: evidence that a signal can cross between brains with a shared convention — demonstrated in early human experiments using EEG and transcranial magnetic stimulation (University of Washington, 2013) and in animal pairs (Duke University, 2013).

pathway.milestone: transfer of a simple, calibrated sensory or emotional state with measurable correspondence
pathway.unlocks: the first real test of whether a state can be reproduced rather than merely triggered.

pathway.milestone: higher-fidelity, bidirectional exchange of richer states
pathway.unlocks: a genuine empathy or knowledge-transfer channel — only if the coding and alignment problems are solved, which remains speculative.
